card.title: Director, Quality Engineering
card.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.**

### **Essential Job Duties**

* **Enterprise Quality Leadership:** Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
* **Standardize Testing Processes:** Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
* **Tooling Ownership:** Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
* **Automation Strategy:** Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
* **Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:**
 + Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
 + Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
 + Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
* **Security & Compliance Testing Support:** Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
* **Customer UAT Support:**
 + Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
 + Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
 + Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
* **Quality Metrics & Reporting:** Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
* **Shift-Left Quality Practices:** Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
* **Incident & Defect Management:** Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
* **Organizational Leadership**: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
* **Release Governance:** Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
* **Coding agent advocacy:** **Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.**

### **Other Job Duties**

* Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

### **Travel Requirements**

* Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

### **Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
* 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
* Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
* Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
* Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
* Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
* Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
* Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
* **AI/ML fundamentals:** Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.

The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.

This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.

HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

card.title: Sr. Manager Quality Sterility Assurance
card.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

**Job Description**

**Title: Senior Manager Quality Sterility Assurance**
-----------------------------------------------------

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Division/Site Specific Information**

Role reports to the Ridgefield, NJ site and reports to the Drug Product Division within the Pharma Services Group.

 

**Discover Impactful Work:** 
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

* In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers.
* You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches.
* Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
* As a member of the Quality Leadership Team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives.
* You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.

**Keys to Success:**

**Education/Experience**
------------------------

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry required.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

 

* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Proficiency with quality management software systems

**Benefits**

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $143,200.00–$214,900.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

card.title: Director of Corporate Quality & Compliance
card.description:
**ABOUT VSE**

We’ve been in business since 1981, founded on the principle of providing the best services to our customers through hard work and a commitment to excellence. VSE provides superior turn-key PCB solutions that exceed industry exacting standards. We provide assembly and engineering services for electro-mechanical products.

VSE exists to empower life-changing and life-saving technologies worldwide. We are successful because of our commitment to exceptional customer service, being nimble, and delivering the highest quality.

Our team members are humble, curious, and electric! We are team players, practicing gratitude and treating others with respect. We are passionate learners, hungry for understanding and eager to explore. We are energized with positivity, wired, and driven to succeed!

Join our team to unlock our dynamic benefits: competitive pay, generous 401k match, flexible schedules, paid time off, holiday pay, health and wellness, along with opportunities for growth and development.

**This role is open to candidates in Reno, Nevada and San Jose, California.**

**Position Summary**

The Director of Corporate Quality & Compliance is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the company's Quality Management Systems (QMS), regulatory compliance, and overall quality performance across multiple manufacturing locations.

This role provides strategic leadership for corporate and site-level Quality functions, ensuring compliance with industry standards, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements while driving a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and maintain the company's Quality Management Systems across all manufacturing locations, including ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and AS9100.
* Establish and execute the corporate quality strategy, including certification planning, QMS development, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FDA regulations and requirements for medical device products and manufacturing processes.
* Oversee manufacturing process validation, including IQ/OQ/PQ, process controls, change management, calibration, and product traceability.
* Lead customer, supplier, internal, and certification audits, ensuring effective corrective actions and ongoing compliance.
* Develop and maintain strong customer quality relationships, leading quality reviews, escalations, and corrective action initiatives.
* Oversee Supplier Quality Management, including supplier qualification, performance monitoring, audits, and corrective actions.
* Drive company-wide quality performance through KPIs, CAPA, 8D, root cause analysis, and risk management.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives, including Lean Six Sigma, 5S, waste reduction, and process optimization.
* Lead and develop Site Quality Managers, Supplier Quality Engineers, and Customer Quality Engineers across multiple locations.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Purchasing, and other departments to identify systemic issues and improve product and process quality.
* Promote a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, risk management, customer satisfaction, and accountability.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality Management, or a related field.
* 10+ years of Quality experience in electronics manufacturing, PCB assembly, or contract manufacturing, including 5+ years leading Quality teams.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 13485, AS9100, and applicable FDA regulations, with experience leading AS9100 implementation and ongoing compliance.
* Experience with medical device manufacturing and process validation.
* Experience managing customer quality, supplier quality, audits, and corrective action (8D, CAPA, root cause analysis).
* Knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620, and J-STD-001.
* Experience implementing Lean, Six Sigma, and 5S.

* ASQ CMQ/OE, CQE, or ISO Lead Auditor certification is preferred.
* Experience supporting aerospace, defense, and medical device customers.
* Experience leading multi-site Quality organizations.
* Strong leadership, communication, and customer relationship skills.

**VSE is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

card.title: Director of Operations
card.description:
**Description**

**Job Overview:**

The Director of Operations provides leadership and oversight for vertical initiatives that enhance operational performance, strengthen community management services, and ensure alignment with evolving legislative and industry requirements. This role serves as the primary expert for change‑management, acting as the central point of accountability for new initiatives, implementation timelines, communication strategies, and reporting outcomes.

Working in close partnership with market leaders and cross‑functional departments, the Director evaluates, tests, and deploys operational improvements that drive efficiency and elevate service delivery. The role also collaborates extensively with Operations leadership across Master Planned Vertical to share best practices, execute strategic initiatives, and support scalable, high‑impact operational enhancements. The Director operates under the direction of the President, Master Planned Communities.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Change Management**

* Provide market oversight for process improvement initiatives, including operational enhancements, legislative implementation, regional, and national program cascades.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and organizational gatekeeper for all change‑management activities, ensuring disciplined execution and alignment with regional and enterprise priorities.
* Own accountability for initiative timelines, implementation plans, communication strategies, and reporting deliverables, including ongoing user acceptance and adoption.

**Operational Excellence & Efficiency**

* Lead the assessment, vetting, testing, and rollout of operational improvements in partnership with market leaders and internal stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to refine or redesign existing programs, procedures, and workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Drive continuous improvement across core community management operations through data‑driven analysis and cross‑functional collaboration.
* Leads compliance within the market with retention programs; NPS, Watchlist, Board Orientation.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with internal departments—including Training, HR, Accounting, Legal, region operations, and Technology—to ensure seamless implementation of operational changes.
* Act as a senior liaison between community management and support departments, ensuring alignment, transparency, and effective communication.
* Facilitate knowledge‑sharing and best‑practice adoption across Hi-rise North markets.

**Regional & Enterprise Engagement**

* Collaborate with Operations leaders on region and national initiatives and create scalable efficiencies.
* Support enterprise‑level initiatives and programs by participating in committees, governance groups, and project teams as requested, i.e. NPS.
* Ensure regional alignment with corporate standards, programs, and strategic priorities. Collaborates with regional operations and Directions (peers) on best practices, process improvement, and standardization across the region, reducing redundancy.

**Reporting & Communication**

* Develop and deliver clear, comprehensive reports on initiative progress, operational integration, and service‑level performance.
* Communicate complex operational changes in a clear, objective, and strategic manner to leadership and cross‑functional partners.
* Maintain a forward‑looking understanding of industry trends, legislative developments, and emerging best practices.
* Consistently uphold the values of the organization and provide the highest level of customer service to internal clients.
* Consistent, motivating, thoughtful leadership style to lead others.
* Must be able to attend and actively participate in night meetings as required.
* Occasional attendance at board meetings.
* Perform any range of special projects, tasks and other related duties as assigned.
* Champion the use of internal and external programs and software to support all roles.
* Other duties may be required.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* Excellent customer service and relationship-building background/skills (internal and external).
* Demonstrated success leading cross‑functional initiatives and driving organizational change.
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority and collaborate across multiple markets.
* Ability to effectively strategize with the overall vision of the organization in mind.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and consistently meet deadlines.
* Demonstrates effective communication skills consisting of oral, written, and listening.

* Demonstrates problem-solving and solving abilities.
* Ability to draft correspondence and respond to inquiries effectively and independently.
* Ability to read and understand financial statements and budgets.
* Must be proficient with computer programs needed for specific positions including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
* Demonstrates organizational skills and time management abilities while working in a fast-paced, multitasking environment.
* Must work effectively with co-workers, customers, and others by sharing ideas in a constructive and positive manner; listening to and objectively considering ideas and suggestions from others; keeping commitments; keeping others informed of work progress, timetables, and issues; addressing problems and issues constructively to find mutually acceptable and practical business solutions; addressing others by name, title, or other respectful identifiers, and; respecting the diversity of our workforce in actions, words, and deeds.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position works under usual office conditions. The employee is required to work at a personal computer as well as be on the phone for extended periods of time. Must be able to stand, sit and walk. The incumbent must be able to work extended and flexible hours and weekends as needed. Physical demands include ability to lift up to 10 lbs.

**What We Offer:**

As a full-time associate, you will be eligible for full comprehensive benefits to include your choice of multiple medical plans, dental, and Vision. In addition, you will be eligible for time off benefits, paid holidays, and a 401k with company match. Occasional travel may be required to attend training and other company functions.

**Compensation:** $90,000-$110,000 annually; paid bi-weekly

**Schedule:** Monday-Friday (9:00AM-5:00PM)

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. card.title: Strategic Operations Director
card.description:
**Location:** New York, NY 
**Compensation:** $170,000 - $190,000 base salary + annual bonus 
**Travel:** 25%

In 2017, Shields established the Strategic Operations team to partner directly with the Executive Leadership Team in executing the company's highest-priority initiatives. These efforts span corporate strategy, operational transformation, performance improvement, growth execution, business development, and new business innovation. Team members gain exposure to all aspects of the organization, combining executive-level engagement with hands-on responsibility for translating strategy into measurable results. The team has served as a pathway to leadership, with alumni advancing into senior roles across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership. This role offers the opportunity to build on that legacy while helping shape Shields' next phase of growth and innovation.

The **Director of Strategic Operations** serves as a senior leader responsible for driving strategic initiatives, operational excellence, and growth across Shields' portfolio of health system specialty pharmacy partnerships. This role is ideal for individuals with experience as a **Healthcare Consulting Engagement Manager, Healthcare Strategy Leader, Strategic Operations Leader, Transformation Leader, Management Consultant, or operations executive within a private equity-backed healthcare services organization** seeking an opportunity to influence enterprise-level decision-making and organizational performance.

Leading a team of high-performing professionals, the Director will oversee complex cross-functional initiatives, deliver executive-level analyses and recommendations, and partner directly with senior leaders to drive exceptional clinical, operational, and financial outcomes. Functioning as an internal strategy and operations leader, this individual will identify growth opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and translate strategic priorities into measurable results across the organization.

This role is particularly well suited for professionals coming from **healthcare consulting, management consulting, healthcare strategy, portfolio operations, business transformation, performance improvement, or private equity-backed healthcare organizations** who are looking for the opportunity to move beyond recommendations and directly own execution. Success requires strong strategic thinking, structured problem solving, financial and operational acumen, executive presence, and the ability to influence stakeholders across a fast-paced, high-growth healthcare environment.

The ideal candidate is a highly analytical and resourceful leader who thrives in entrepreneurial settings, excels at managing ambiguity, and has a demonstrated track record of leading strategic initiatives that drive growth, value creation, operational excellence, and performance improvement.

**Job Duties**

Strategic Leadership & Team Development

* Serve as a key leader within the Strategic Operations team, driving growth, strategic execution, and organizational performance through both direct leadership and individual contributions.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of high-performing professionals responsible for supporting critical business initiatives across the organization.
* Oversee the planning, execution, and monitoring of strategic and operational initiatives aligned with Shields' highest-priority objectives.
* Synthesize complex operational, financial, and market insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

### **Strategy, Operations & Performance Improvement**

* Partner directly with Senior Vice Presidents and Regional Vice Presidents of Operations to drive strong financial, operational, and clinical outcomes across Shields' health system partnerships.
* Collaborate with operational leadership to identify, prioritize, and execute strategic objectives while ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
* Lead day-to-day strategy and operational execution for a portfolio of health system partnerships.
* Develop business cases, financial models, forecasts, and performance analyses to support executive decision-making.
* Drive high-impact initiatives focused on operational excellence, growth strategy, performance improvement, transformation, and value creation.
* Conduct analyses to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, process improvement, and partnership expansion.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior operational leaders, providing strategic guidance and analytical support.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Finance, Business Development, Clinical, Technology, Human Resources, and Executive Leadership teams.

### **Partnership & Stakeholder Management**

* Own and cultivate relationships with senior health system executives and key external stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic liaison between Shields leadership and health system partners to ensure alignment on priorities and objectives.
* Support executive presentations, partnership reviews, business planning sessions, and strategic steering committees.
* Translate complex analyses into compelling executive-level presentations and recommendations.

### **Growth & Innovation**

* Identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities, ancillary services, operational enhancements, and growth initiatives that increase partnership value.
* Support strategic planning, business development, market expansion, and innovation efforts across the organization.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive dynamics, and emerging healthcare opportunities to inform strategic decision-making.

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree required; MBA, MHA, MPH, or other advanced degree strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of professional experience with a demonstrated track record of strategic and operational leadership within healthcare.
* Experience in one or more of the following environments strongly preferred:
 + **Healthcare Consulting Firms** (Engagement Manager, Manager, Project Leader, Senior Manager, Principal, or equivalent roles)
 + **Private Equity-Backed Healthcare Services Organizations**
 + **Corporate Strategy, Strategic Operations, Transformation, Portfolio Operations, or Performance Improvement Functions**
 + **Health Systems, Specialty Pharmacy, Provider Services, Population Health, Revenue Cycle, or Healthcare Services Organizations**
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy development through implementation and performance measurement.
* Proven ability to drive operational excellence, business transformation, growth strategy, and performance improvement initiatives in complex healthcare environments.
* Experience developing and presenting strategic recommendations, performance updates, and business insights to executive leadership teams and Board-level audiences.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, business case development, forecasting, and executive-level presentations.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to solve complex business problems using data-driven approaches.
* Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading through influence in highly matrixed organizations.
* Proven self-starter with the ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and workstreams simultaneously.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Healthcare industry experience strongly preferred.
* Willingness to travel approximately 25% to engage with health system executives, operational leaders, pharmacists, clinicians, and partnership stakeholders.

Why Join Shields?

* Partner directly with Executive Leadership on the company's most important strategic priorities.
* Lead high-impact initiatives that drive growth, operational excellence, and transformative outcomes across a national network of health system partnerships.
* Gain broad exposure to corporate strategy, healthcare operations, business development, and executive decision-making.
* Join a proven leadership pipeline that has developed future leaders across Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership.
* Help shape the future of healthcare through innovative specialty pharmacy solutions that improve patient outcomes and strengthen health system partnerships.

card.title: Senior Director, Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, Remote
card.description:
Working in the Office of the Chief Medical Officer and reporting to the VP of Point of Care & Risk Stratification, the Senior Director of Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, will lead day-to-day operations, partnerships, go-to-market efforts, and wraparound support services to maximize the impact of Aledade’s value-based care insights to our partner practices.

The team is looking for a high-output generalist with a strong business analyst toolkit, looking to rapidly take ownership of complex content with high visibility, working across multiple stakeholders. Candidates that thrive managing multiple deadlines on tight timelines and learning content quickly are best positioned to succeed; successful team members in the same function primarily have backgrounds in consulting and generalist healthcare strategy & operations roles.

To start, the role will focus on 1) scaling the deployment of our point of care tools and 2) broadening and deepening the insights available in our point of care tools, to maximize the impact of Aledade’s insights on our patients’ health outcomes and partner practices’ success in their value-based care contracts.

At the end of their first year, a successful leader in the role will own end-to-end accountability for 1) proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials, 2) strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact, 3) goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools, 4) identification, evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships that support insight delivery and impact.

Additionally, this role will 1) provide direction and expert guidance to junior team members owning individual initiatives, including incentive and adoption programs, educational efforts, hotspotting, monitoring, and alerting development, practice and user-level prioritization and triage, and 2) coordinate with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade to advance point of care tool adoption and impact.

The role is expected to start as a senior individual contributor, but is expected to grow into a people manager in the near term.

### **Primary Duties:**

In collaboration with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade:

* Own single-threaded accountability for proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials

* Lead strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact

* Drive goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools

* In support of maximizing insight delivery and impact, lead the evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships

* Direct and support other Transformation team members’ ideation and execution of strategic initiatives related to point of care deployment and impact

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Economics, Business, Healthcare, or a related field
* 12+ years of progressive professional experience, or 7+ years progressive professional experience with a Master’s Degree, strongly preferred
* 6+ years of experience in healthcare
* 2+ years of experience in value-based care

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced exploration of emerging AI tools, with additional preference given to individuals that have demonstrated ability building, scaling, and/or teaching AI tooling to broader teams
* Expert Excel skills required, including the ability to work with large, complex, & often incomplete data sets; conduct one-off complex analyses quickly; and utilize Index / Match, XLOOKUP, FILTER, and other advanced formulas
* Advanced PPT skills required, including storyboarding skills, ability to translate complex analyses and concepts into engaging slides, and ability to draft executive-level materials with limited direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to build strong relationships and work with individuals at all levels of the organization, tailoring communication style as appropriate based on audience
* Excellent project management skills, including proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in health care operations settings
* Strong strategic planning and analytical skills
* Strong “business analyst” toolkit, including abilities to independently prioritize, solve problems via hypothesis-driven analytical methods, manage across multiple responsibilities and projects, execute with attention to detail, and overcome ambiguity
* Poise, confidence, and maturity interacting with key stakeholders, including senior leaders
* Commitment to confidentiality and discretion in appropriately handling sensitive information is required

### **Physical Requirements:**

Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays

12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents

Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service

Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program

401(k) with up to 4% match

Stock options

And much more!

*At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.*

 

We may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help organize and evaluate application materials. These tools support our recruiters and hiring managers by helping manage large applicant pools. Human judgment plays an essential role in our hiring process, including in the oversight and use of any automated tools. If you would like more information about our screening and hiring process, please contact us. Our Commitment to Authenticity. We use Endorsed, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Aledade PBC using Lever, a cloud services provider located in the United States. Lever is engaged by Aledade PBC to help manage its recruitment and hiring processes. For more information about how your personal data will be processed by Aledade PBC and any rights you may have, please review Aledade PBC’s Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying for this job, you agree to Aledade's Applicant Privacy Policy available at https://www.aledade.com/privacy-policy-applicants If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact privacy@aledade.com.

card.title: Head of Operations - Wealth Management
card.description:
*South Key is conducting a confidential search for a Head of Operations for one of its clients.*

**Head of Operations, Wealth Management Service Delivery** 
Remote (U.S.; Eastern or Central time zone preferred) · Full-time · Reports to the COO 
Starting base salary $150,000 plus bonus

**About the company**

We are a growing operations partner to registered investment advisors. Our team works as an extension of our clients' staff, handling financial planning support, investment operations, new business processing and client service so advisors can focus on their clients and their growth.

**The role**

The Head of Operations is a leadership role, accountable for service delivery, quality, capacity and team performance across all of our client firms. You will lead a remote team of 20+ across client service, investment operations and financial planning, and build the team-lead layer beneath you.

You will stay close to daily operations, but you will lead through your team leads and managers rather than doing the work yourself. This is not a working-supervisor role. Over the next year, you will build an operation that can support significant client growth.

**What you'll do**

Service delivery and quality 
- Own timely, accurate delivery across all operations service lines. 
- Set service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures. 
- Track turnaround times, SLA commitments, errors, NIGOs, rework and client feedback, and fix the root causes of recurring problems. 
- Serve as the senior escalation point for significant delivery issues.

Team leadership 
- Lead, coach and develop team leads and staff with clear responsibilities and performance expectations. 
- Run consistent training, performance reviews and accountability. 
- Partner with recruiting to define staffing needs, interview candidates and onboard new hires. 
- Build career paths, cross-training and backup coverage that support retention.

Capacity and delivery economics 
- Keep a forward-looking 60–90 day view of workload, staffing, skills and available capacity. 
- Measure capacity and put the right staffing structure in place, including team-lead and manager roles, as the business grows. 
- Recommend hiring and resource allocation based on demand, service requirements and financial impact. 
- Balance productivity with quality and sustainable workloads. 
- Make sure new client start dates line up with operational readiness.

Process improvement and onboarding 
- Build, standardize and document core workflows while allowing for differences between client firms. 
- Improve workflows to reduce manual work, errors and unnecessary handoffs, partnering with the technology team on automation and system changes. 
- Own operational readiness for new client engagements: staffing, training, workflows and handoffs.

Reporting 
- Maintain a weekly operations scorecard covering quality, service levels, capacity, staffing and delivery risks. 
- Turn performance data into clear actions, owners and deadlines, and own the department's quarterly priorities.

**What you'll bring**

* 3–5 years of direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management and staffing decisions. Project leadership alone is not enough.
* Experience overseeing multiple operations functions, such as client service, new business and account opening, money movement, investment operations and financial planning support.
* Experience developing team leads or managers who run their own teams.
* A track record of building and scaling an operation, not only maintaining one: building processes, improving workflows, measuring capacity and putting the right staffing structure in place as the organization grew, with measurable improvements in turnaround time, accuracy, productivity or service levels.
* Experience leading operations or advisor services in wealth management at an RIA. Custodian candidates are welcome if they have led advisor-facing service operations and understand how independent RIAs operate across client service, new business and investment operations.
* Hands-on knowledge of advisory firm workflows: account opening, transfers, custodian requirements, client service and operational accuracy.
* RIA candidates: experience at a firm with more than $500M AUM. $1B+ is preferred.
* Experience leading remote teams.
* Direct, collaborative communication and confidence handling difficult performance conversations.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Salesforce, Redtail and common custodian platforms.
* Workflow automation or process-improvement experience.
* Experience with a structured operating or accountability framework (for example EOS).

**Your first 90 days**

* Get to know the team and each client's delivery requirements.
* Assess immediate service, staffing and coverage risks.
* Clarify responsibilities and escalation paths across operations.
* Set baseline metrics and weekly reporting.
* Build a 60–90 day capacity forecast and a prioritized improvement plan.

**How to apply**

This search is confidential and is being handled by South Key. Company details will be shared with qualified candidates after an initial conversation.

Pay: $150,000.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

card.title: Front of House Director of Operations
card.description:
**Front of House Director of Operations**
=========================================

**Chick-fil-A | Eldorado & Ridge**

* Full-time
* Starting from $24.00 per hour
* 6201 Eldorado Parkway, McKinney, TX, US, 75070

Description

Front of House is your business and you are expected to own it. Front of House rises and falls on you. You will be measured based on the performance of your business and evaluated on how effective and efficient your business is being run. Effective ownership of this role includes identifying critical systems that need to be created or refined in the kitchen to achieve our Winning Hearts Every Day strategy metrics. The Director understands how to leverage strategic partnerships with high performing Directors, Managers, or Team Leads that are passionate and engaged in the business to ultimately achieve excellent business results. The Director is responsible for following through with all Leadership pertaining to implementation, accountability, and utilization of the created systems and restaurant processes.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Talent**

* Proactively monitoring & tracking FOH staffing par levels
* Partnering with HR Administrator to ensure FOH workforce numbers are sufficient for operational excellence across all dayparts.
* Partnering with HR Administrator within the hiring process
* Screening & interviewing Team Member applicants based on HR interview guide
* Screening & interviewing FOH Leadership applicants based on HR leadership interview guide
* Proactively documenting disciplinary issues & coaching conversations with FOH Managers appropriately to ultimately support HR Director.

**Leadership Development**

Conduct reoccurring monthly one-on-one coaching sessions with all FOH Managers ensuring:

* Each FOH Manager has a development plan in place and understands what is needed to achieve their next step.
* Each FOH Manager is adhering to necessary operational hard skills & processes.
* Follow up monthly on development goals.
* Utilize the one-on-one time to identify opportunity areas, and areas of success.
* Set action plans for Leadership and set follow up meetings.

Oversee Leadership Development for all HOH employees, working closely with the Management team to ensure mid-level leaders have development plans.

Partner with HR Administrator to conduct quarterly audits for all FOH Leadership Team roles and responsibilities.

Participate in weekly Manager meetings

**System Development**

Forecasting & Scheduling

* Proactively monitoring local ISD calendars to ensure restaurant dayparts are adequately staffed when school is out thus minimizing business disruption.
* Partnering with FOH Director to review and adjust forecasted sales projections ensuring 97% or higher efficiency between system forecast sales and adjusted forecast sales.
* Adjust schedule to reflect shift feedback notes from FOH Managers and Team Leaders.
* Responding to FOH employee requests off in a timely manner
* Holding FOH Managers/Coordinators/Team Leads/Captains/Employees & Seasonal Employees accountable to weekly shift minimums
* Reviewing previous week’s schedule productivity and labor totals to identify wins and areas of opportunities.

FOH Visuals & Dashboards

* Establishing a system for ensuring all FOH posted visuals and digital systems for tracking Winning Hearts Every Day metrics are always relevant, up to date, and meet visual identity standards.
* Create or uphold organization of each station by ensuring that a schematic is in use for each section.
* Establishing a system for ensuring each FOH position has a positional expectation card clearly posted and up to date meeting visual identity standards.

Food Safety & Food Cost

* Performing weekly audit of Daily Safe Critical manager assessments
* Maintaining a score of 1 on Food Safety Report every quarter
* Utilizing timers, temperature checks and lean iPads for production
* Ensuring all items are labeled and stored with proper rotation
* Establish and communicate Mock Food Safety Audit Schedule
* Execute lean ordering, thawing, prep, and cooking

FOH/Facilities/Equipment/Storage Cleanliness & Organization

* Develop a schedule for detail cleaning for each piece of equipment
* Develop a schedule for detail cleaning of each “zone” or restaurant area
* Hold all FOH Managers/Coordinators/Team Leads accountable to systems across all dayparts to cleanliness & organization standards

Inventory & Product Accountability

* Ensuring FOH Managers are conducting weekly inventory spot checks.
* Ensuring FOH Managers systematically understand & participate in Month End Inventory counting process.
* Oversee Supply Chain Team Members to ensure proper inventory levels are maintained.

**Gap Analysis & Strategic Planning**

* Weekly audit & gap analysis of specific Analytics Hub reporting relative my HOH business.
* Weekly audit & gap analysis of Customer Experience Monitor metrics compared to monthly & quarterly business goals
* Weekly audit of Customer Experience Monitor comments to identify gaps in operational systems or leadership
* Weekly FOH overall reporting to Director Team & Operator on Director following EOS principles
* Weekly auditing of restaurant FOH smallwares and partnering with Administrative/Financial Director concerning smallwares budgeting and expenditures.
* Conducting monthly & quarterly Director action planning and evaluating your plan to ensure alignment with our shared organizational goals.
* Participating in Quarterly Team Wide Meetings to provide insight surrounding FOH Systems & People performance.
* Participating in Director Team Annual Strategic Planning

**Day to Day Operations**

* In operations as the business demands
* Ensure time punches are accurate with HR Administrator on a weekly basis
* Oversee overtime hours with HR Administrator on a weekly basis
* Ensures there are systems in place that provide accountability and drive improvements within the team
* Assist Director team with responding to Customer Cares Priority 1 submissions within 24 hours.
* Assist Director team with responding to any security, fire, or temperature management calls.
* Ensures team is consistently following the Safety Policies outlined in the Employee Handbook
* Ensures Managers & Team Leads are adhering to Chick-fil-A quality systems daily.
* Ensures Managers & Team Leads are adhering Operator’s expectations daily.
* Call out changes needed with digital checklist systems based on key learnings from customer feedback & insight.
* Proactively partnering with Sr. Director of Business Development to address all FOH equipment or facility repairs needed.
* Following up with vendors to ensure quality of services provided pertaining to equipment or facility repairs.

**Communication and Visibility**

Serves as a communications liaison between Director Team and Manager/Team Lead level Leadership

* Provides detailed information and organization of quarterly Chick-fil-A rollouts
* Communicates in Slack to provide instantaneous feedback with team and create levels of engagement as well as accountability.
* Communicates on business platforms in a manner that aligns with our culture by design mindset and exemplifies our organization’s core values.

Rewards FOH Managment & Team Leads using VSBL who demonstrate:

* Exceptional experience to guests or employees, specifically in providing a clean and safe environment, fast and accurate food production and contributing to organization goals.
* Our core values consistently to guests or employees, specifically guest comments or within leader surveys where employees are mentioned by name.

Requirements

Proven track record of facilitating Leadership Development within a team.

Understanding and experience analyzing restaurant metrics and financial reports, restaurant gap analysis and labor management..

3+ years in a leadership role.

Physical demands associated with this job include sitting, standing, walking, lifting, carrying, reaching, pushing, and pulling.

Ability to work in a collaborative leadership team.

Basic computer skills, and the ability to learn and utilize various software.

Strong interpersonal communication skills.

Bilingual strongly preferred.

Company Information

At Chick-fil-A Eldorado & Ridge we want to build an outstanding team that works hard and has fun! Our goal is to create a gathering place for the community that gives Team Members an opportunity to grow and develop while Winning Hearts Everyday. Here at Chick-fil-A, every Team Member role is more than just a job, it's an opportunity to gain valuable life skills that will help you succeed in any path of life you choose.

### **Why Work at Chick-fil-A Eldorado & Ridge?**

Chick-fil-A is more than just a job—it's a place to grow, lead, and make a difference. As one of the most respected and successful restaurant brands in the country, Chick-fil-A is known for excellence not only in food quality and customer service, but also in how we treat and invest in our Team Members.

**Competitive Pay**

**Local Ownership and Servant Leadership**

* Work directly with Owner/Operator **Matt Bridges** who is known for genuine hospitality and strong leadership.

* In our Restaurant, we serve others first.

**Nationally Recognized Employer**

* **#1 in Customer Service** – Year after year, Chick-fil-A leads the fast-food industry in customer satisfaction according to the **American Customer Satisfaction Index**.
